تمتعضن (form VIII)
# تَمْتَعِضْنَ (tamtaʕiḍna) /tam.ta.ʕidˤ.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِمْتَعَضَ (imtaʕaḍa)
# تُمْتَعَضْنَ (tumtaʕaḍna) /tum.ta.ʕadˤ.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِمْتَعَضَ (imtaʕaḍa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
